sections.title: Objective type questions of two 1-mark parts.

questions.q: True or False: (a) f(x) = 1 (x ≠ 0), 2 (x = 0) is continuous at x = 0. (b) f(x) = |x| is continuous at all points of R.
questions.answer:
(a) False — the limit at 0 is 1 but f(0) = 2.
(b) True.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (a) lim x→1 (x⁴ − 1)/(x − 1) = ______. (b) lim x→0 (e^(2x) − 1)/x = ______.

or.answer:
1 − cos x = 2 sin²(x/2).
2 sin²(x/2)/x² = ½[sin(x/2)/(x/2)]² → ½ × 1 = ½.

questions.answer:
For x > 3 the expression is 1; for x < 3 it is −1.
RHL = 1 ≠ LHL = −1, so the limit does not exist.

tan²x = sin²x/cos²x = (1 − cos x)(1 + cos x)/cos²x.
(1 + cos x)cos²x/[(1 − cos x)(1 + cos x)] = cos²x/(1 − cos x) → 1/(1 + 1) = ½.

questions.q: If f(x) = ax − 1 (x ≠ 3) and f(3) = 5 is continuous at x = 3, find a.
f(x) = (1 − cos 4x)/x² for x < 0, a for x = 0, √x/(√(16 + √x) − 4) for x > 0. If f is continuous at 0, find a.
questions.answer:
LHL: 1 − cos 4x = 2 sin²2x ⇒ 2 sin²2x/x² = 8[sin 2x/(2x)]² → 8.
RHL: rationalise: √x(√(16 + √x) + 4)/(16 + √x − 16) = √(16 + √x) + 4 → 4 + 4 = 8.
Continuity: a = 8.

questions.q: Determine a and b so that f(x) = |x − 2|/(x − 2) + a (x < 2), a + b (x = 2), |x − 2|/(x − 2) + b (x > 2) is continuous at x = 2.
